seed_ledger.name: Apollo North Pipeline
seed_ledger.reason: Still monitor. Williams lists the Apollo North Pipeline for the Apollo plant beside Meta's Bowling Green data center, so the data center tie is met, but no length, start point or route was found. A July 2026 local article and a farmland dispute story describe only a Will-Power gas line for Meta, rerouted around one farm; an advocacy source says two 16-inch lines. The Ohio Power Siting Board docket 26-0275-GA-BLN is not indexed and the plant case 25-973-EL-BGN names no pipe length. Existing row P8311 is Apollo South. EIA workbook, FERC and Ohio EPA air permit searches named no North line. Searches run: 8 across the three seeds. Sources checked: Williams project page (names North line), BG Independent News (route change, Meta only), OPSB news release (plant only), web search for docket (nothing).

evidence.note: Williams page lists Apollo North Pipeline for the Apollo plant
Will-Power gas pipeline serves only Meta's data center; route moved off one farm; no length

seed_ledger.name: Aristotle North Pipeline
seed_ledger.reason: Still monitor. Williams lists Aristotle North beside Aristotle South (P8313) and Central (P8312) for the Socrates plants serving Meta in New Albany, and an Ohio historic preservation list shows an Aristotle North project from the siting board in December 2025, but no length, route or diameter was found in any loadable source. Docket 25-1163-GA-BLN could not be read. Searches for the North line by name, case number and plant name returned only the South line (17.9 miles, 24 inch). Searches run: 8 across the three seeds. Sources checked: Williams Socrates page (names North line), Ohio historic preservation list (project exists), OPSB notice for South line (no North), web searches (nothing for North).

evidence.note: Williams page lists Aristotle North Pipeline

seed_ledger.name: Clarington Connector
seed_ledger.reason: Still monitor on length. New this pass: Natural Gas Intelligence (February 2026) shows a map route linking EQT's system in Belmont and Monroe counties, Ohio, to Marshall County, West Virginia, and quotes EQT saying the line lets more gas reach data center demand; 400 MMcf/d, end of 2026 per EQT and 2028 per EIA. No length, diameter, filing or investment decision found. Not P7794 Borealis and not EQT's separate 50-mile POWER Pipeline (open season August 2026). Searches run: 8 across the three seeds. Sources checked: NGI (route and data center quote), RBN (capacity), EIA August 2026 workbook (data center note, length blank), Pipeline and Gas Journal (budget), Marcellus Drilling News (separate POWER line), Ohio PUC and FERC searches (nothing).

evidence.note: map route Belmont/Monroe OH to Marshall County WV; data center demand quote; 400 MMcf/d
